---
title: "mecompare"
subtitle: "Marginal effects and cross-model comparisons of effects in Stata"
---
<<dd_version: 2>>

`mecompare` calculates marginal effects and compares them across models. It fits
the framework of Mize, Doan, and Long (2019): the models are combined with
[`suest2`](../suest2/index.html) so that the difference between a marginal effect
in one model and the same effect in another has a proper standard error, even
though the models were estimated separately.

The comparisons it handles include effects across nested models (mediation and
confounding), across alternative predictors, across different outcomes, across
different model types (for example ordinal versus nominal), and across models fit
to separate groups or samples. It also compares effects within a single model.

## Installation

```stata
net install mecompare, from("https://tdmize.github.io/data/mecompare") replace
```

`mecompare` calls [`suest2`](../suest2/index.html) and works with
[`metest`](../metest/index.html), which tests contrasts between rows of the
`mecompare` table. Each installs the same way.

## Where to start

- [Getting started](getting-started.html) walks through one comparison and
  explains the table.
- The **Examples** in the sidebar reproduce the examples from Section 6 of
  Mize, Doan, and Long (2019) plus a within-model comparison.
- The help file (`help mecompare` in Stata) documents every option.

## Citation

If you use `mecompare`, please cite:

> Mize, Trenton D., Long Doan, and J. Scott Long. 2019. "A General Framework
> for Comparing Predictions and Marginal Effects Across Models."
> *Sociological Methodology* 49(1): 152--189.
> <https://doi.org/10.1177/0081175019852763>

## Related commands

::: {.command-table}
| Command | What it does |
|:------|:-------------------------------------------------------------|
| [`suest2`](../suest2/index.html) | Combines separately estimated models so that quantities from different models can be tested against each other. The engine underneath `mecompare`. |
| [`metest`](../metest/index.html) | Tests contrasts between rows of the tables produced by `mecompare`, `meinequality`, and `totalme` (or any posted `margins` results). |
| [`meinequality`](../meinequality/index.html) | Summarizes how unequal the marginal effects of a categorical predictor are across its categories. |
| [`totalme`](../totalme/index.html) | Summarizes a predictor's effect across all outcome categories of a multiple-outcome model in a single Total Marginal Effect. |
:::
